info.name: Dash0 Edge Collectors Manage Time Series Aggregations (Private BETA) API
Get a specific time series aggregation by origin or ID

params.name: originOrId
params.description: Time series aggregation origin or UUID

items.docs: Returns a specific time series aggregation identified by its origin label or UUID.

info.name: Update or create a time series aggregation by origin or ID

params.name: originOrId
params.description: Time series aggregation origin or UUID

items.docs:
Updates an existing time series aggregation or creates a new one if it doesn't exist.
Useful for Infrastructure-as-Code workflows.

info.name: Delete a time series aggregation by origin or ID

params.name: originOrId
params.description: Time series aggregation origin or UUID

items.docs: Deletes a specific time series aggregation identified by its origin label or UUID.

info.name: List all time series aggregations for the organization

items.docs: Returns all time series aggregation rules configured for your organization.

info.name: Create a new time series aggregation

items.docs:
Create a new time series aggregation rule for your organization. If
`metadata.labels["dash0.com/origin"]` is provided, it must be unique within the
organization and dataset; a request with a duplicate origin returns 400. If no
origin is provided, the server auto-generates one.
